description: Defines overlay widget classes and enums for ANGLE project, including widget types, IDs, and specific widget classes like Count, PerSecond, Text, RunningGraph, and RunningHistogram.

classes.name: Widget
classes.description: Base class for overlay widgets, providing common properties and interface.

classes.name: Count
classes.description: Widget class representing a count of events.

classes.name: PerSecond
classes.description: Widget class representing a per-second event count.

classes.name: RunningGraph
classes.description: Widget class for displaying a graph of recent values.

classes.name: RunningHistogram
classes.description: Widget class for displaying a histogram of values between 0 and 1.

classes.name: Dummy
classes.description: No-op class used when overlay is disabled.

methods.name: RunningGraph(size_t n)
methods.description: Constructor for RunningGraph, initializes with size n.

methods.name: set(float n)
methods.description: Sets the histogram value based on a float between 0 and 1.

methods.name: add(size_t n)
methods.description: Adds n to the count or value.

methods.name: next()
methods.description: Advances to the next value in the graph or histogram.
